name: engineering-strategy
description:
Write a living engineering strategy in the repo you are working in.

- engineering-strategy: When staff-plus or architecture work needs a living strategy, run explore, diagnose, refine, policy, and operations; write docs/engineering-strategy.md or docs/<slug>-engineering-strategy.md in reader order.
- strategy-explore: When you have not yet explored the problem, write the implicit rules in this repo, the alternatives, and what others already do for this kind of problem, to docs/<slug>-strategy-explore.md.
- strategy-diagnosis: When the challenge is unclear, write a theory of the problem, the dissenting views, and the data that exists, to docs/<slug>-strategy-diagnosis.md.
- strategy-refine: Before you roll a strategy out widely, pick test, map, model, both, or skip, and write docs/<slug>-strategy-refine.md.
- strategy-operations: When guiding policies already exist, write how you inspect them, the exception path, and the review cadence.
- strategy-evaluate: When a living strategy file already exists, read how fast you can iterate, what the next test costs, and whether the file still fits the diagnosis, then write docs/<slug>-strategy-evaluate.md and leave the strategy file as it is.
